queries:
WITH acc AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS acc_avg
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
reg AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(acc_avg) AS figure
  FROM acc
  GROUP BY region
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(figure) AS avg_figure FROM reg
)
SELECT reg.region, reg.figure, reg.figure - overall.avg_figure, reg.figure / overall.avg_figure
FROM reg, overall
WHERE reg.figure > overall.avg_figure;
SELECT account_id,
       AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount
FROM trans
GROUP BY account_id;
SELECT d.A3, AVG(COALESCE(t.avg_amt, 0)) AS avg_per_account_amount
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amt
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
) t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY d.A3;
